title: ClasificadosOnline keyword search
description: Search Puerto Rico classifieds across all categories without browsing the listings UI. Local experimental adapter; no public source review.

tools.name: search_classifieds
tools.description: Search ClasificadosOnline Puerto Rico across all categories by keyword. Returns up to 30 listings, prices when present, towns, seller names, URLs and category facets. Use page for more results, or a returned category id to narrow. Read only; no contacting sellers or posting ads.

keyword.description: Search phrase, 1–120 characters, e.g. Toyota, apartamento, electricista.

page.description: Page number, 1–100. Default 1. Each page contains up to 30 listings.

category.description: PR searches all categories (default). To narrow, use an id returned in categories.
